title: Cooldown Hud
description: Cooldown HUD shows small Visual models of the cooldowns on your items to help you in gameplay. A simple light weight mod to overhaul cooldown visuals.
body:
Cooldown HUD is a lightweight, stylish, and fully customizable HUD mod that displays item cooldowns directly on your screen — clean, minimal, and built for players who want information without clutter.

Cooldown HUD is a sleek, performance‑friendly mod that adds a simple on‑screen display for item cooldowns. Whether you're tracking ender pearl throws, totem cooldowns, ability timers, or custom plugin cooldowns, this mod gives you a clear visual indicator without breaking immersion.

Designed to be minimalist, responsive, and highly readable, Cooldown HUD blends into any UI style while giving you the info you need at a glance.
